course_name: 土壤與結構物互制行為
outline: •	Deformations and stresses for soil/structure interaction depend on the mechanical properties of both the soil and structure. This course introduces the students the mechanical behaviour of the soil in the vicinity of deep basement excavation, pile foundation, and retaining wall. The course will first provide information for the design of propped and cantilever retaining walls constructed in stiff clay that frequently pose various problems. Selected case histories are given to illustrate the relevant design features. The second part of the course introduces the students the tools i.e. centrifuge and numerical modelling that are commonly used in the study of soil/structure interaction problem.

Week 16: FLAC Workshop
